description: Get genetic inheritance mode and clinical timeline for a rare disease by its Orphanet ORPHAcode. Returns inheritance modes (e.g. Autosomal dominant, X-linked recessive, Mitochondrial), average age of onset (e.g. Neonatal, Infancy, All ages), and disease group/typology classification. Supports 12 languages (en, fr, de, es, it, pt, nl, pl, cs, tr, uk, zh). Source: Orphadata / Orphanet — CC BY 4.0, no auth, unlimited free.

lang.description: Response language (default: en). Supported: en, fr, de, es, it, pt, nl, pl, cs, tr, uk, zh.

orphacode.description: Orphanet ORPHAcode of the rare disease to get inheritance mode and age-of-onset data for (e.g. 558 for Marfan syndrome).

name: orphadata.raredisease.disease_natural_history

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Orphadata Rare Disease Natural History
